top_stories.title: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 4 Neon: 1M Context, #1 on AA Coding Agent Index
top_stories.description: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, a 1M-context Gemini 4 model priced at $3/$15 per million tokens. It scores 61 on the AA Intelligence Index and ranks #1 on AA’s Coding Agent Index. top_stories.title: AI discovers a hidden heart signal that could predict sudden death
top_stories.description: Scientists have uncovered a hidden warning sign in routine heart scans that could predict sudden cardiac death before it strikes. The AI-powered discovery outperformed conventional screening methods, potentially revealing thousands of people at risk of a fatal heart malfunction that doctors might otherwise miss.

top_stories.title: AI-powered bionic eye breakthrough could help the blind see again
top_stories.description: Scientists have developed an AI-powered approach that makes experimental bionic vision technology more precise, helping predict the flashes and shapes of light perceived by a blind man with a brain implant. By learning how an individual's brain responds to electrical stimulation, the technology could bring researchers closer to restoring some degree of sight to people with blindness.

top_stories.title: Meta FAIR Self-Improving Memory Hits 56.0 on Continual Learning Bench
top_stories.description: Meta FAIR’s Self-Improving Memory lets Kimi-K2.6 write its own LOAD and OFFLOAD memory prompts, then distills them into its weights. Optimized prompts score 56.0 versus 44.6 for the best hand-written harness on Continual Learning Bench.
